subject: general
question: The compound interest on a certain sum of money for 3 years at 10% p.a. is Rs. 1,324. Find the simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum, at the same rate and for the same time.
solution:
**Formula:**

A = P × (1 + Rover100)n

A = CI + P

SI = P× R × Tover100, where

A = Amount

P = Principal

CI = Compound Interest

R = Rate

T = Time

n = Total number of times

**Calculation:**

Aover P = (1 + 10over100)³

⇒ P+CIover P = (1 + 10over100)3

⇒​1 + CIover P = (11over10)3

⇒​CIover P = 331over1000

Substituting the value of CI, we get,

⇒ P = 1324× 1000over331 = Rs 4000

SI = 4000 × 3 × 10over100 = 1200

**∴ The simple interest for the sum is Rs 1200.**
